text:
## Escalation & Authorities  
| Fraud Amount | Investigation Level | Approval Authority | Timeline |
|---|---|---|---|
| **<£500** | Routine | CSR | 2–3 days |
| **£500–£5,000** | Standard | Manager | 3–5 days |
| **£5,000–£50,000** | Enhanced | Risk Manager | 5–7 days |
| **>£50,000** | Complex | Head of Crime + Legal | 7–14 days |
| **Serial/Pattern** | Specialized | Head of Crime + Police | 10+ days |  
---
name: Chunk 21/24

raw_entities.name: Level 1 — Routine Fraud Investigation
raw_entities.description: Frontline escalation level for fraud cases under £500. Handled by Customer Service Representatives with a 2–3 day response timeline. Represents the initial triage and investigation tier for low-value fraud incidents.
context: Fraud Amount <£500 | Investigation Level Routine | Approval Authority CSR | Timeline 2–3 days

raw_entities.name: Level 2 — Standard Fraud Investigation
raw_entities.description: Supervisor-level escalation for fraud cases between £500 and £5,000. Requires Manager approval with a 3–5 day investigation timeline. Represents mid-tier fraud handling with increased scrutiny.
context: Fraud Amount £500–£5,000 | Investigation Level Standard | Approval Authority Manager | Timeline 3–5 days

raw_entities.name: Level 3 — Enhanced Fraud Investigation
raw_entities.description: Department-head-level escalation for fraud cases between £5,000 and £50,000. Requires Risk Manager approval with a 5–7 day investigation timeline. Involves enhanced due diligence and risk assessment.
context: Fraud Amount £5,000–£50,000 | Investigation Level Enhanced | Approval Authority Risk Manager | Timeline 5–7 days

raw_entities.name: Level 4 — Complex Fraud Investigation
raw_entities.description: Executive-level escalation for high-value fraud cases exceeding £50,000. Requires joint approval from Head of Crime and Legal with a 7–14 day investigation timeline. Involves comprehensive investigation and legal review.
context: Fraud Amount >£50,000 | Investigation Level Complex | Approval Authority Head of Crime + Legal | Timeline 7–14 days

raw_entities.name: Level 5 — Specialized Serial/Pattern Fraud Investigation
raw_entities.description: Specialized escalation level for serial or pattern fraud cases involving repeated or coordinated incidents. Requires joint approval from Head of Crime and Police with a 10+ day investigation timeline. Involves law enforcement coordination.
context: Serial/Pattern | Investigation Level Specialized | Approval Authority Head of Crime + Police | Timeline 10+ days

raw_entities.name: Customer Service Representative
raw_entities.description: Frontline role responsible for routine fraud investigation and approval for cases under £500. Operates within a 2–3 day response timeline.
context: Fraud Amount <£500 | Investigation Level Routine | Approval Authority CSR

raw_entities.name: Manager
raw_entities.description: Supervisory role responsible for approving standard fraud investigations for cases between £500 and £5,000. Operates within a 3–5 day response timeline.
context: Fraud Amount £500–£5,000 | Investigation Level Standard | Approval Authority Manager

raw_entities.name: Risk Manager
raw_entities.description: Department-head-level role responsible for approving enhanced fraud investigations for cases between £5,000 and £50,000. Operates within a 5–7 day response timeline.
context: Fraud Amount £5,000–£50,000 | Investigation Level Enhanced | Approval Authority Risk Manager

raw_entities.name: Head of Crime
raw_entities.description: Executive-level role responsible for approving complex fraud investigations exceeding £50,000 and specialized serial/pattern fraud cases. Works jointly with Legal or Police as required.
context: Fraud Amount >£50,000 | Investigation Level Complex | Approval Authority Head of Crime + Legal
Serial/Pattern | Investigation Level Specialized | Approval Authority Head of Crime + Police

raw_entities.name: Legal
raw_entities.description: Legal function responsible for joint approval of complex fraud investigations exceeding £50,000. Provides legal review and guidance on high-value fraud cases.
context: Fraud Amount >£50,000 | Investigation Level Complex | Approval Authority Head of Crime + Legal

raw_entities.name: Police
raw_entities.description: External law enforcement authority involved in joint approval and investigation of serial or pattern fraud cases. Coordinates with Head of Crime on specialized fraud investigations.
context: Serial/Pattern | Investigation Level Specialized | Approval Authority Head of Crime + Police
